The literature name INU1 (inulinase) for the locus RefSeq annotates as SUC2, beta-fructofuranosidase (556 aa, chr 1). It is the reciprocal best hit of S. cerevisiae SUC2 (YIL162W; 52% identity, 95-99% mutual coverage), so the ortholog is assigned normally. The curator also reports an extra C-terminal inulin-binding domain, which the alignment does not show. INU and INU1A (literature names) are the same gene and are merged into INU1.
